meta.title: Kgf chapter 2
meta.tagline: An empire forged in blood and gold faces its ultimate battle for supremacy.
description: The blood-drenched territory of the Kolar Gold Fields, famously known as KGF, has fallen under the control of a formidable new overlord: Rocky. To his loyal allies, Rocky is a revered savior who brings hope to their lives. However, his rapid rise to power has struck absolute terror into the hearts of his adversaries, who now tremble at the mere mention of his name.

As Rocky relentlessly pursues unchallenged supremacy, he faces immense opposition from all sides. The government views his iron-fisted reign as a severe threat to law and order, while a host of bitter enemies clamor for revenge and actively conspire to orchestrate his downfall. With vengeance fueling his rivals, even bloodier battles and darker days lie ahead for the new king.
